'''2011 Bespin Regionals Tanner Barnhurst LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tanner Barnhurst]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' QMC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
